resources.string: Balances quality and available bandwidth. Recommended.
Up to 360p, 15 fps. Uses less data and camera processing.
Less data for voice. Speech may sound less detailed.
Up to 1080p, 30 fps when the camera and network allow. Uses more data.
More bandwidth for voice detail. Does not improve a poor connection.
Applies to your outgoing audio and video from the next call on this phone. Every mode can reduce quality when the network worsens. Incoming quality and data use also depend on the other person.
